sleeping_bag.name: X-LITE 400
sleeping_bag.subtitle: extremely light 2-3 season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: X-Lite is positioned as an extremely light 2-3 season sleeping bag built around aggressive weight reduction without sacrificing functional comfort. Cumulus highlights the combination of ultralight Toray Airtastic fabric, a light 3 mm 2/3 YKK zip, a slim cut, a shark-fin footbox and a 3D hood, paired with ethically sourced 900 FP Polish goose down.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 575 g total weight
- 400 g of 900 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort -1 C / limit -7 C / extreme -24 C
- Toray Airtastic 19 g/m2 shell and liner
- 7D ripstop, DWR finish, 100% nylon
- 3 mm YKK 2/3 zip with 2 self-locking sliders
- 3D hood
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- Trapezoid chamber design
- Differential cut
- Stuffsack and storage sack included
- Customizable via configurator
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus presents the X-Lite series as the lightest sleeping bags in the world by weight-to-warmth ratio. The design is intentionally minimalist and free from unnecessary components that would add weight, while remaining comfortable and highly compressible.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Fast-and-light use, users prioritizing low pack weight and compactness, trail running, ultramarathons, bikepacking, sport rock climbing.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: Official locale and page context show different current prices and lead times. The configurator default price is lower than the observed EU product/category price.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty name shown on product and category pages. General Cumulus warranty page adds that defects in craftsmanship/materials are covered when used as intended, with paid repair available for non-warranty cases.
